title: Paperclip-ing budget contract (fleet FinOps -> upstream costs)
description: The frozen budget seam between the fleet's FinOps tiers and budget rail (governance/finops/, gateway/finops/, telemetry/budgets/) and the upstream cost surface (issue #370, ADR-0013). A budget has a scope, a period, a cap and spend, a currency, a hard-stop flag, a burn-rate alert threshold and a receipt reference. See docs/PAPERCLIP-ING-INTEGRATION.md.

scope.description: What the cap applies to. Upstream caps per agent (also per team/project).

level.description: The scoping level of the cap.

id.description: The agent / team / project id the cap applies to.

period.description: The budget window (fleet: month — the vendor cap window in telemetry/budgets/budget.py).

cap.description: The spend limit for the period. At the cap the run hard-stops with a graceful hand-off.

spent.description: Spend already consumed in the period.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency of cap and spent (fleet vendor caps are USD).

hard_stop.description: True when the cap is absolute: spend at or above it always stops, whatever the policy.

burn_rate_alert_pct.description: Burn-rate alert threshold, as a percentage of cap, that warns before the hard stop (fleet: warn_at_pct / hard_cap_pct).

receipt_ref.description: Per-task receipt reference backing the spend (fleet: the audit/ledger entry; upstream: the cost receipt).
